correctness.rationale: The Hermitian lifting splits by a real 3-point Fourier transform into a 2x2 block and two equal scalar blocks. Exact trace, determinant and crossing-polynomial identities yield all four squared singular values; the crossing function is strictly increasing with a single root in (1,4/3). Before the root the condition number is strictly decreasing by a certified exponential inequality; after it the normalized Gram block increases strictly in Loewner order. Explicit Fourier inversion proves injectivity. CHECK.py independently evaluates the matrix spectrum, symbolic identities, rational exponential bounds and recovery tests. The proof is global over all radii, unlike numerical probes.
